description: This file defines the MemorySessionStorage class implementing session storage interface for in-memory session management in a PHP web application, including methods for session lifecycle and bag management.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: Implements in-memory session storage with methods for starting, regenerating, and managing session bags.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the session, always returns true.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the session has started, always returns true.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns an empty string as session ID.

methods.name: regenerate
methods.description: Regenerates the session, optionally destroying old session data.

methods.name: getBag
methods.description: Retrieves a session bag by name, throws exception if not registered.

methods.name: getMetadataBag
methods.description: Returns the metadata bag associated with the session.
